messages:
joe-sales: Quick ask — AcmeBank wants to schedule a key-swap cutover for BYO-CMK (CloudHSM) in their POC next week. They need answers: 1) can we rotate keys with zero-RTO? 2) any billing delta during cutover? 3) presales checklist for attestation + network egress. Ping engineering + security.

maria-crypto: Short answer: zero-RTO depends on proxy vs direct keystore mode. If using key-proxy (in-proc handshake) we can do rolling swap w/ no request downtime. If they are doing synchronous HSM calls per-request, expect a brief failover window ~10-30s during cutover.

sam-engineer: We have a runbook for rolling swap — can share. Main constraint is connection churn to customer HSM endpoints and DNS TTL. If they use an internal proxy with sticky sessions we'll be fine.

ryan-sre: Also watch throughput: during swap we may fallback to cached encrypted keys leading to higher mem usage. Recommend pre-warming burst capacity.

joe-sales: Billing question — does rotation trigger an extra 'BYO' call charge or reserved capacity bump?

maria-crypto: No automatic capacity bump. But if you request a warmup (extra dedicated pods) that is billable. Rotation itself is just KMS calls — billed per-request. If we run a prep job to re-encrypt large datasets via our migration tool that's charged as data-migration.

sam-engineer: Sample acceptance criteria I'm proposing:
- No 5xxs for >99% of requests during cutover
- Latency P95 within 2x baseline for <15 minutes
- Post-cutover token audit log with KID mapping
I'll paste small runbook snippet.

sam-engineer: ```bash
# one-line example: generate new CEK and rotate
redwood kms rotate --customer-key-id KID123 --mode rolling --verify
# verify via:
redwood audit get --after ts --filter key_id=KID123
```

kate-ps: Can we get a short blurb for legal/security questionnaire (SIG) on mutability/rotation? Customer asked for rotation frequency, key custody, and attestation docs.

maria-crypto: I'll draft: 'Customer-managed keys (CMK) support: BYO-CMK via CloudHSM/AWS KMS. Keys are never exported. Rotation supported via API; recommend 90d minimal rotation cadence. Attestation: provide HSM vendor cert + tamper-evidence logs. We support HSM-backed asymmetric keys + KMIP proxies.'

joe-sales: @kate-ps can you add this to the SIG response and flag anything missing? Also customer wants estimated E2E cost delta — include likely extra requests and optional pre-warm cost.

kate-ps: Yep — I'll draft and send to legal. Need a ballpark pre-warm price: sam any numbers? else I'll use conservative estimate.

sam-engineer: For typical POC (50k requests/day) pre-warm for 2 hours on dedicated = ~$150. Re-encrypt migration depends on data size.

security-bot: automated-note: attached attestation template (link) and previous HSM cert. See: https://internal/redwood/hsm-attestations/acme-template

ryan-sre: :thumbsup: I'll run a quick chaos dry-run in staging tomorrow morning 09:00 PT and report any regression.

joe-sales: Thanks all — I'll relay to customer and schedule the window after the staging dry-run. @maria-crypto please confirm the final SIG text by EOD. :pray:

kate-ps: On it. Will update thread when sent.
